name: fl_domain_adr_manager
description: Domain vocabulary and 3-Gate Architectural Decision Record (ADR) governor. Evaluates decisions against the 3 Gates (reversibility, surprisingness, trade-offs), manages GLOSSARY.md alignment, and logs out-of-scope rejections to prevent cyclic discussions.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'evaluate_3_gates' (default, tests whether an idea justifies an ADR), 'scaffold_adr' (generates ADR-xxx markdown), 'update_glossary' (upserts term to GLOSSARY.md), or 'log_out_of_scope' (records rejected proposal to .out-of-scope/).

title.description: Title of the architecture decision or ADR topic.

hard_to_reverse.description: Gate 1: Is this decision difficult or costly to reverse later? ('true' or 'false').

surprising_without_context.description: Gate 2: Would a future developer find this decision surprising or counter-intuitive without written context? ('true' or 'false').

has_real_tradeoffs.description: Gate 3: Was there a genuine alternative considered and rejected with clear trade-offs? ('true' or 'false').

consequences.description: Positive and negative consequences of the decision.

repo_root.description: Path to workspace root. Defaults to current directory ('.').

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
